title: Randomized Evaluation of Vascular Entry Site and Radiation Exposure: REVERE Trial
brief_summary: The study compares radiation exposure parameters between coronary angiography procedures performed by left wrist, right wrist or groin (femoral) procedure access site
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients undergoing diagnostic coronary angiography

Exclusion Criteria:

* non-availability of one or more of the three access sites History of coronary artery bypass graft surgery Need for percutaneous coronary intervention.
study_population: Patients referred for diagnostic coronary angiography
